title: Even After 9 Years, This is Still Goku’s Best Kamehameha in Dragon Ball Super
content: Dragon Ball has featured its fair share of iconic moments over the decades, but few can come close to Goku’s most iconic Kamehameha. While Kamehameha is far from new, it’s easily one of the most memorable techniques in all Shonen.

title: Dragon Ball Super Already Locked In the Next Z Fighter & They Need Their Anime Debut
content: Almost every Dragon Ball arc adds another warrior to the Z Fighters, and Granolah looks like he could be next. The last remaining Cerealian boasts all the key characteristics that fit into Goku’s band of highly moral misfits.

title: Criterion Channel Adds Speed Racer Anime
content: Shout! Studios released the Speed Racer anime on digital platforms in June 2024. The company released both the English-dubbed version and the original Japanese version Mach GoGoGo on video-on-demand. Shout! Studios also released the entire series on Blu-ray Disc on August 25.
author: ANN

title: Grotesqqque Anime Film Screens in Los Angeles on December 3 for 1-Week Only
content: Aniplex of America announced on Thursday that it will screen Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) at Alamo Drafthouse Cinema Downtown Los Angeles for one week only starting on December 3. Tickets are on sale on the theater's website .
author: ANN

title: Omoi Announces Digital Release of Shō Asahina's Tsuyo-Girl Manga in January
content: Digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Thursday the exclusive digital release of Shō Asahina 's Tsuyo-Girl manga on its website and app in January. Omoi will release the manga with the English title Tsuyo-Girl: Taking Charge .
author: ANN

title: This World is Worth Fighting For Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content: Hatsumi Kodama 's This World is Worth Fighting For ( Kono Yo wa Tatakau Kachi ga Aru ) manga is getting a live-action series on Fuji TV in January 2027. Hiyori Sakurada stars as Ito Kiri. Kaede Kamiya is directing the series. Yasuko Kuramitsu is writing the screenplay. Ito Kiri has had enough.
author: ANN

title: hololive Shop Reports Customer Information Leak
content: OPENLOGI had announced that its systems were subject to unauthorized access between November 8-9. The hololive shop outsourced shipping operations to OPENLOGI until June 2025, but it has since stopped using its services.
author: ANN

title: Getbackers Manga Gets Comic Anime From AI Platform MangaNow Studio
content: A new official X/Twitter account for Yuya Aoki and Rando Ayamine 's GetBackers manga announced on Wednesday that the series is getting a comic anime on YouTube on December 1. AI platform MangaNow Studio is directing, producing, and editing the comic anime.
author: ANN
